claims.statement: AddCoreServices creates the shared MongoDB client from ConnectionStrings:MongoDb; MongoDbDatabaseService receives that client, defaults its database to the lowercase bot name, and delegates connection and chat-settings work to MongoConnectionManager and MongoChatSettingsRepository.

MongoConnectionManager obtains the bot database handle once in its constructor and has no reconnect or disconnect operation; database statistics failures are logged and return null without sending a notification.

MongoChatSettingsRepository stores settings in the ChatSettings collection, uses bot-scoped HybridCache keys tagged with the bot name, persists the default language when a chat has no language, and drops the cached chat-ID list on every settings update without loading it.

TestBot stores every GIF record in a single GifData collection keyed by a compound _id of ChatId then UserId, upserting a chat and user's record; MongoDB-backed Identity is configured separately with the BotFarmIdentity database name.

BackupDatabase writes per-collection BSON ZIP entries plus an indexes/<collection>.bson entry of index definitions inside the coordinator's RunWithUpdatesPausedAsync, buffers each serialized document in memory, returns failure with an alert when the pause cannot be confirmed, deletes the partial archive on failure or cancellation, and prunes old archives only after success.

Restore runs inside RunWithUpdatesPausedAsync and stages each ZIP entry in a separate collection using batches of up to 500 documents; it replaces the destination by rename only after staging succeeds, replaces empty collections too, and cleans staging artifacts on failure. The restore is not atomic across all archive entries.
LocalBackupHelperService stores timestamped ZIP archives per bot under the data folder's backups directory and, by default, retains the seven newest archives by creation time.

Focused backup tests cover refusal when pausing fails, partial-archive removal on read failure and cancellation, index-definition backup and restore, 500-document batching, empty-collection replacement, target preservation with staging cleanup when staging, index creation, or rename fails, cache clearing after restore, and alerting after restore exceptions.

MongoBotControlStateStore persists each bot's desired enabled state, command ID, and timestamp in a dedicated BotFarmControl.BotControlStates collection keyed by bot name; runtime applied status remains process-local.
BotControlState deserialization ignores unknown BSON fields, allowing records with the removed Revision field to remain readable.
Backup and restore resolve the selected bot's database service through IBotRegistry; the per-bot archives therefore exclude the separate BotFarmControl database used for durable bot desired state.

Database-service chat and collection counts default to MongoDB estimated counts and support exact counts when requested; the shared count helper selects EstimatedDocumentCountAsync or CountDocumentsAsync accordingly.

MongoConnectionManager lets collection-list and BSON-read exceptions propagate, while collection create, drop, population, rename, and index-creation failures are logged, notified, and returned as false; reading index definitions omits the _id_ index and returns an empty list for a missing collection.
TestBot's chat-wide reads and deletes use an _id range from {ChatId, UserId: MinKey} to {ChatId, UserId: MaxKey}, which depends on GifDataKey serializing ChatId first.

MongoDbDatabaseService.MigrateChat does nothing for equal chat IDs, otherwise moves chat settings first and then calls the virtual MigrateBotChatData hook (a no-op by default); a hook failure propagates and leaves the moved settings in place.

MoveChatSettings copies the source settings as raw BSON under the target ID before deleting the source, keeps existing target settings on a duplicate key, returns NotFound/Moved/KeptExisting, and invalidates both chats' cache entries and the chat-ID list.
TestBot's MigrateBotChatData upserts each source GIF record under the target chat with $setOnInsert in an unordered bulk write, so existing target records win, then deletes the source chat's records.

MongoDbDatabaseService.DeleteChat deletes the bot's own per-chat data through the overridable DeleteBotChatData hook before deleting chat settings, and a hook failure propagates leaving the settings so the chat stays listed for retry.
DeleteChatSettings deletes the settings document by _id, removes the chat's cache entry and the cached chat-ID list, and returns whether a document existed.
TestBot deletes a chat's GIF records when the chat is deleted by overriding DeleteBotChatData with ClearChatData.

Restore creates the archived index definitions on the staging collection before renaming it over the destination, falls back to the destination's current indexes when the archive has no index entry for that collection, and treats index-creation failure as a staging failure.
After every restore attempt, successful or not, MongoDbBackupService removes all HybridCache entries tagged with the bot name so cached chat settings cannot outlive restored data.
